title: Peacemaker National Training Center
specs: Over 40 gun ranges including two 1,000-yard ranges
Located in Blue Ridge Mountains near historic Civil War battlefields and Appalachian Trail
Proof of military, law enforcement, medical provider, or firefighter credentials for discounted membership
Basic Handgun Safety and Marksmanship: Pistol, 3 magazines/revolver speed loader, 150 rounds, appropriate attire, eye and ear protection, brimmed hat

Defensive Pistol Level 1: Basic handgun course required; pistol, 3-5 magazines, 1-2 magazine pouches, 250 rounds, Kydex holster, appropriate attire, eye and ear protection, brimmed hat; cloth holsters prohibited

Intermediate Carbine: Completion of basic carbine course or equivalent; AR-15 with 20 inch barrel max, rifle case, optics, 200 rounds, 5 magazines, 2 mag pouches, 2-point sling, med bag with tourniquet, notebook, hearing and eye protection

Advanced Carbine: Completion of intermediate carbine or equivalent; AR-15 20 inch barrel max, rifle case, optic, 250 rounds, 2 mag pouches, sling, med bag with tourniquet, bipod or front shooting bag, rear bag, hearing and eye protection

NVG Level 1: Solid understanding of AR and AK platforms; helmet with mount, NVG, zeroed rifle with sling, infrared laser, range belt with mag pouch, 200 rounds, proper attire, hearing and eye protection
Ranges and training available for law enforcement, military, federal agencies, commercial organizations, and private clients
On-site classrooms accommodate up to 30 students
